headline: African Financial Institutions Report Surge in Digital Fraud as Cross-Border Finance Expands
summary: Digital fraud has surged to 88% among surveyed financial institutions across 20 African countries, while only 11% are connected to the PAPSS cross-border payments network.
why: Cross-border payment infrastructure and digital security compliance are foundational for scaling financial technology and investment flows across African markets.

impacts.name: Financial Services
impacts.why: High levels of digital fraud increase operational risk and compliance costs for regional financial institutions.
